task.description: Run the full test suite (mix letflow.check.test or mix test, whichever is this project's standard full-suite command -- check mix.exs aliases) on this branch, synchronously in the foreground per core-directives.md's 'No Background Wait For A Cross-Turn Notification' section -- do not background it. Report the real pass/fail counts. For any failure, apply core-directives.md's 'Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching' -- attribute each failure to either this branch (blocks) or pre-existing/environmental (file-and-forward per ISSUE_QUEUE.md, does not block). This branch's diff touches lib/letflow/application.ex, lib/letflow/supervisor/pollers_breaker.ex (new), test/letflow/supervisor/pollers_test.exs, test/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure_test.exs, test/letflow/supervisor/pollers_breaker_test.exs (new) -- pay particular attention to any failure in or near the supervisor/ test directory, since that is where a genuine regression from this branch would surface; a failure in an unrelated file/subsystem is a stronger candidate for pre-existing/environmental per route 1 of the Failure Attribution rule (module not in git diff --name-only main...HEAD).
acceptance_criteria: Full suite run synchronously, real output quoted (not summarized from memory)
Every failure attributed via one of the 3 structural routes, named explicitly -- 'known failure' or count-matching alone is not acceptable
test/letflow/supervisor/ directory's own tests (all 4 files) confirmed passing, quoted separately
A structured test report written to test/reports/ per this role's standard output
